signal: Clearspeed raised a $60M Series D (total $110M) to expand its dual-use voice-based risk assessment platform, now used in 37 countries across 60 languages

email.body1:
Bob, saw Clearspeed raised its $60M Series D to expand the voice-based risk assessment platform across insurance, finance, and government.

Scaling that fast usually means more accounts in play across verticals than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Clearspeed off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Bob, quick follow-up for Clearspeed.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can, and a dual-use motion across insurers, banks, and agencies multiplies the addressable list. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit the new number.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Clearspeed needs across those verticals this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Bob, last bit of proof for Clearspeed.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Clearspeed reply rate likely compares to other funded AI teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Bob, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority right now, no problem. The post-raise expansion stretch is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a multi-vertical motion? I will tailor it to Clearspeed either way.
